items.title: Anthropic Below Its IPO Price: Do Giants Come Back?
items.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share. It closed its first day, Thursday, Nov 19, at $97.17. Then it fell for three straight sessions. On Tuesday, Nov 24, it closed at $81.91. That left it 1.3% below its offer price, on only its fourth trading day.

items.title: Should You Buy Uber Stock For Its Cash?
items.summary: Uber Technologies produced free cash flow equal to 8% of its market value at Monday's close. The median S&P 500 company stood at 4.4%. Free cash flow is the cash left from operations after spending on equipment and property. For Uber, it came to $10.4 billion in the twelve months to September.
